brief:
Israeli forces detained and mistreated a group of school students in the Al-Jalatiya area, east of Idhna in the Hebron region, Eye on Palestine reported. The incident occurred in the eastern part of the occupied West Bank territory.

No further details were immediately available about the number of students involved, their ages, the specific allegations of mistreatment, or the circumstances that led to the detentions.

title: Israeli forces detain school students in Hebron area
